title: DEF CON 22 - Adrian Crenshaw- Dropping Docs on Darknets: How People Got Caught
summary: Adrian Crenshaw's DEF CON 22 talk gives an overview of Tor and I2P, then goes through real cases where darknet users were caught. These include Silk Road and its operator.
why: HN points to it to show that most Tor busts came from poor operational security by the user rather than a flaw in Tor itself.

quote.text: in most of the cases, it was bad OpsSec by the person, and had nothing to do with Tor
